scenes.title: Biggest tire on a stock Jeep Wrangler JK (2-door)?
33 in (e.g. 285/70R17)
scenes.body: JEGS puts the stock-height limit at about 33 in.

scenes.title: 35x12.50 or 285/75R17
scenes.body: 285/75R17 works on factory 17s; 35x12.50 wants 18x9 or 20x9 wheels at about 0 to +1 mm offset.

scenes.title: 37 in
scenes.body: JEGS says 37s need about 3.5 in of lift and advises axle, driveshaft and gearing upgrades; 40s need about 4.5 in.

scenes.title: Every size, every lift.
scenes.body: Follow for a new truck every day.
